d:
Protests continue outside a local branch of Punjab National Bank (PNB) in Greater Noida for the third day, as villagers, many of whom got compensation from the UP government for the Jewar airport project, say their fixed deposits and bank accounts have been emptied out in a massive fraud.
Police have registered an FIR and begun their investigation.
According to a senior Gautam Buddha Nagar police officer, around Rs 16 crore was missing, and around 18 people—most of them farmers—had complained to them about their money being drained from their accounts.
